operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained

operations.sourceMutability: mutable index containing exact immutable versions
operations.controlledAbsence: fatal identity failure for a mapped catalog package; optional dependency-property omission is not field absence
operations.privacySecurity: Public package metadata only; scripts, tarballs, source, and candidate code are never fetched or executed.
operations.completenessSemantics: Exact publication proves a package adoption fact; exact controlled dependency names and ranges prove only declared positive framework or datastore facts; omission never proves incompatibility or no requirement.

operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.controlledAbsence: missing or non-normal compose.json entry is qualified unknown and never a deployment negative
operations.privacySecurity: Only exact root entry metadata is retained; no recursive tree or unrelated paths are retained.

operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.controlledAbsence: missing, invalid, unsupported, or services-empty content yields qualified field unknown and never a negative claim
operations.privacySecurity: Strict UTF-8 JSON is parsed inertly with 262144 decoded-byte, 100000-node, and depth-32 limits; no commands, scripts, images, or candidate code are run.
operations.completenessSemantics: Content and Git blob digest must agree; a closed JSON object with a nonempty object-valued services map emits compose-service-declaration only, with complete deployment semantics explicitly unresolved.

freshnessPolicy.mutableSources: retain collectedAt, effectiveAsOf, source identity, source record digest, completeness including partial, and source-is-mutable limitation
freshnessPolicy.immutableSources: bind exact commit, root tree, blob, release, advisory, or package version
freshnessPolicy.partialEvidence: retain source and field completeness separately plus explicit unresolved remainder
freshnessPolicy.replayClock: committed cutoff only; ambient time is prohibited

publicationFlow: pure offline complete-profile and partial-evidence projection
separate extraction-path, full-closure, and per-cell-origin report
